svg.aria-label: A reusable optimization record and its search card; a new description is matched to stored records by retrieval-augmented generation and the stored algorithms reused.
svg.text: Preserve optimization algorithms together with their problem and evaluation context
One linked record for reuse and continued improvement
Retrieval-augmented matching of a new description (RAG)
Top-ranked cards are given as context

g.text: Review the scores of the stored algorithms
Improve algorithms with newer, more capable LLMs
Kept algorithms return to later instance review
Shading illustrates scores; + marks a new candidate
